title: Repository-host discovery pin race canary
mission: Exercise the canonical GitHub proposal-claim path with two or more create-if-absent attempts for one deterministic discovery fingerprint, preserve the winner bytes, record collision evidence for losers, and verify that neither pin nor proposal acquires queue/execution/promotion authority.

unblock_value.reason: Closes the exact remaining boundary reported by the discovery-dedup implementation before repository-host atomic pinning can be treated as evidence-backed.

regression_prevention.reason: Falsifies overwrite or duplicate-pin behavior on the real repository host rather than trusting filesystem-only race tests.

fail_if: more than one durable winner exists for the same fingerprint
a loser overwrites or mutates winner bytes
the canary requires queue/Current/Human Accepted/Served promotion to pass
